description: Reference periods for which no DMI observation is published, and why. Release summaries that compare across one of these months name it and give this reason. Listing a period here publishes nothing and estimates nothing; it only explains an existing gap.

periods.reason: the required official CPI comparison data are unavailable
periods.detail: BLS did not publish October 2025 CPI because of the 2025 federal government shutdown. October 2025 is the 12-month base month for October 2026 inflation, so the October 2026 DMI cannot be computed. It is not estimated, interpolated or backfilled.
